rationale: Lorenzo's work on high-quality datasets and data annotation for LLMs at Abaka AI directly complements Matt's infrastructure and AI foundation leadership across Linux Foundation and the Agentic AI Foundation. Matt's focus on ML infrastructure and agentic systems could benefit from understanding production data pipelines and annotation workflows that power the models he's architecting at the foundation level.
intro_message: Lorenzo, meet Matt White — Global CTO of AI at Linux Foundation and lecturer at UC Berkeley who leads infrastructure strategy for agentic AI systems; your dataset and annotation expertise at Abaka AI could be valuable context for the foundation work he's driving.
